Can you suggest some biography and autobiography books written by John Lukacs?

gpt-4o-mini.title: Churchill: Visionary and Eccentric
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A compelling biography that explores the complex personality and vision of Winston Churchill through the lens of John Lukacs' insights.

gpt-4o-mini.title: The Duel: The Eighty-Day Struggle Between Churchill and Hitler
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: This work provides a detailed narrative of the critical moments in the conflict between Churchill and Hitler, showcasing Lukacs' historical perspective.

gpt-4o-mini.title: The End of the Twentieth Century and the End of the Modern Age
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: Lukacs reflects on the profound changes of the twentieth century, blending autobiography with historical commentary.

gemma2:9b.title: A History of the Twentieth Century
gemma2:9b.explanation: Comprehensive overview of the 20th century, focusing on historical turning points and intellectual movements.

gemma2:9b.title: Hitler
gemma2:9b.explanation: A comprehensive biography by John Lukacs that delves into the complexities of Adolf Hitler's life and ideology, exploring the historical context and impact of his actions on the 20th century. This work offers a nuanced perspective on one of history's most controversial figures.

gemma2:9b.title: November 1940: The Tragedy of Hitler's Decision
gemma2:9b.explanation: In-depth analysis of Hitler's decision to launch a campaign against Britain in November 1940.
